messages:
nina: Quick thread- CloudWave wants a private marketplace offer bundling our Dedicated credits + their HW discount. They want a coordinated announce tied to their partner day (2026-07-14). Need pricing bands, SKU names, and renewal mechanics. who can own?
carlos: I can draft bands. prefer 12mo commit with quarterly true-ups. include optional 24mo locked pricing.
rachel: Sales wants a short enrollment credit to accelerate Q3 pipeline (apply to months 1-2). Also need clear rules for HW rebate pass-through.
jb: Legal note: do not promise HW rebate without signed partner MSA. Marketplace copy should reference "partner-managed rebate" and link to PO. Add auto-renew opt-out clause.
nina: Assignments: Carlos -> pricing + SKUs; Rachel -> field one-pager + enrollment credit calc; JB -> redline contract language; I'll coordinate announce blurb.
comms-bot: Proposed internal announce 2026-07-10, public listing + joint press 2026-07-14. Confirm by EOD Fri.
carlos: Draft tiers (USD, 12mo): Starter $8k/mo -> 7% disc; Growth $45k/mo -> 14% + $12k HW pass-through; Enterprise $140k/mo -> 22% + $40k HW pass-through + 2w fast-start. optional 24mo -> +3% off.
rachel: OK from sales. JB, can you add renewal accelerator language? e.g., 5% one-time credit if customer renews within final 90d.
jb: Good to include, conditional on partner approval and usage caps. I'll post clause by EOD.
nina: Great. Carlos, drop SKU names when ready. Ping if blocked. Thanks!
